About SudokuIQ

Choose classic Sudoku or Sudoku-X for an extra diagonal constraint. Both reward careful deduction. In classic Sudoku, each row, column, and 3-by-3 box contains the digits 1 through 9 without repetition. Sudoku-X adds the same requirement to both long diagonals.

How to play

  1. Choose Sudoku or Sudoku-X and a difficulty level.
  2. Fill empty cells with numbers while following the puzzle’s rules.
  3. Use the import/export feature to save your progress for another session, or reveal the completed puzzle.
